subsystems.name: Ingestion and chunking
subsystems.role: break source documents into retrievable passages and attach metadata.
parts: text extractors for PDF, HTML and office files
metadata taggers for source, date and section

subsystems.name: Embedding and vector index
subsystems.role: convert passages into vectors and store them for fast similarity search.

subsystems.name: Query understanding
subsystems.role: turn a user question into one or more effective search queries.

subsystems.name: Retrieval and fusion
subsystems.role: fetch candidate passages from multiple retrieval methods.
parts: hybrid fusion such as reciprocal rank fusion

subsystems.name: Reranking
subsystems.role: reorder candidates by relevance using a more expensive model.

subsystems.name: Generation and refinement
subsystems.role: produce an answer from retrieved context and check or improve it iteratively.

buildSteps.title: Ingest source documents
buildSteps.detail: Collect files, web pages or database records; extract plain text; remove duplicates and boilerplate.

buildSteps.title: Chunk text
buildSteps.detail: Split into passages of a few hundred words with overlap; store metadata such as source, date and section.

buildSteps.title: Embed and index
buildSteps.detail: Compute a vector for each passage with an embedding model; insert into a vector database that builds an approximate nearest neighbour index.

buildSteps.title: Build query pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Add a module that rewrites, expands or decomposes the user's question into one or more search queries.

buildSteps.title: Retrieve candidates
buildSteps.detail: Run dense and sparse retrieval in parallel over the index; combine results with a fusion method such as reciprocal rank fusion.

buildSteps.title: Rerank
buildSteps.detail: Score the top candidates with a cross-encoder that reads the query and passage together; keep the highest-scoring passages.

buildSteps.title: Generate with context
buildSteps.detail: Pass the selected passages and the original question to a large language model with instructions to answer using only that context and to cite sources.

buildSteps.title: Refine iteratively
buildSteps.detail: If the answer is incomplete or low-confidence, reformulate the query, retrieve again and regenerate; repeat for a set number of rounds.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate and monitor
buildSteps.detail: Measure retrieval and answer quality on a labelled test set; log queries and outcomes to detect drift and improve the pipeline.

prerequisites.why: they provide fast similarity search over large collections of embeddings, which keyword search alone cannot match.
they map text to dense vectors that capture semantic meaning, enabling retrieval by intent rather than exact words.
they generate fluent answers from retrieved context and can follow instructions to cite sources.
they score query–passage pairs jointly, greatly improving precision over vector similarity alone.
combining dense and sparse retrieval covers both semantic and keyword matches, making retrieval more robust.
metrics for faithfulness and context relevance are still maturing, so quality assurance is partly manual.

pathway.milestone: hybrid retrieval plus cross-encoder reranking is the standard for enterprise search and assistants
pathway.unlocks: accurate, source-cited answers over private document collections.

pathway.milestone: agentic RAG where the model decides when to retrieve, which tools to call and how many steps to take
pathway.unlocks: handling complex, multi-hop questions without a fixed pipeline.

pathway.milestone: long-context models and better chunking reduce the number of retrieval steps, but retrieval remains essential for freshness and provenance
pathway.unlocks: simpler pipelines with lower latency for many tasks.

pathway.milestone: self-improving RAG that tunes chunking, embeddings and reranking automatically from user feedback and evaluation signals
pathway.unlocks: pipelines that adapt to new domains with minimal engineering.
